name: Luna
dof_breakdown: legs, arms, waist and neck; 27 active
summary: LimX's stage-facing humanoid, wrapped in textile rather than moulded plastic to read as calm rather than industrial. It runs the second generation of the company's SYS 0 motion engine, includes fall recovery, force-limited joints and collision detection, and can pick up a dance routine from a video clip — the pitch is malls, theme parks and role-playing NPCs.
notable: Fabric-wrapped body designed for public performance

sources.title: LimX Dynamics unveils Luna humanoid robot — TechNode
